guide.line: Levi Strauss was born Löb Strauß on 26 February 1829 in Buttenheim, a village in the Kingdom of Bavaria, into a Jewish family.

guide.line: In 1847, with his mother and sisters, he emigrated to the United States, sailing from Bremerhaven.

guide.line: In New York he joined the dry-goods business run by his older brothers and learned the trade of importing and selling cloth and household goods.

guide.line: He became a United States citizen in 1853 and, like tens of thousands of others, turned his eyes west toward the California gold rush.

guide.line: On 20 May 1873 the United States granted Patent No. 139,121 to Jacob Davis, "assignor to himself and Levi Strauss & Company."
